steps.name: Color of emotions (9)
steps.objective: Talk to [Minuet] at “Adrica” and go to [Notos] at “Nereis Gate”.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Uh, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: For some reason, I felt like I had to come to Minuet… . Nothing much has happened so far, right? No, were you okay?
(Minuet looks slightly surprised when asked how she is. Then she returns to her usual expressionless expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet? Why are you surprised?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: It's a greeting with a different feel than before. For a moment, I felt so good when they asked me how I was… .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, I was fine. Adrika is also peaceful. It's all thanks to Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: It's really nice to be able to see Lapier from Adrica. %s, are you alright?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I also had a good time. Oh, I've been to a new area in the meantime.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: It must be because of the witch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since a long time ago, the Demon World has tried to continue connecting the world we live in. Iris said that he felt such an attempt recently... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Among them, there was also a force trying to connect the demon world here... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Witch… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I am gathering information with your help. So I was able to meet new witches in a new area.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Tell us about your time there… .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I think I might be of help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I will. What happened first... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Minuet about what happened on Aie Island.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I was a bit surprised that there was an incarnation there.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I'd like to see you someday... . I didn't recognize it, but you recognized me... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I wonder what kind of person the ancient god who was his master was. Gaia might know.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: You said the name of the place full of magically powered gates is Nereis Gate, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right, the Nereid Gate.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: If it is a place that many people visit and is full of magic, there might be a clue about the hourglass.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that we're talking about it, I'll go look for the hourglass. Nothing major has happened yet, but it's still good to check.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Come back… . Thank you for sharing your story… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Minuet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I’ll have to ask Notos.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: What does it feel like to be given the gift of the will to live? .

steps.name: Color of emotion (10)
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Notos] at “Nereis Gate” and go to [Hayden] at “Aie Island”. 
2. Catch the monsters on “Aie Island” and obtain “Letter to My Brother”, then return to “Nereis Gate” and report to [Notos].

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Welcome, %s. I was already talking about Edam and %s, I never thought you would come like this.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Hello, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello. You two were together.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: You followed the Elias expression given by Yeonhee. When a tiger dies, it leaves behind its skin... .

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Notos, I think you were confused with another expression. It was said that when a magpie cries, a welcome guest is coming... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: That's right. Yeonhee told me so much that I must have been mistaken for a moment.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Anyway, I'm sorry for not being able to greet you properly at that time. It's my fault.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: As the person in charge of the gateway, I should have properly checked the gate, but I put the users at risk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not Notos' fault.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Many people, including Your Majesty, said it was okay, but it was my arrogance to believe that the gate was full of knowledge.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I think we need to do more research in the future. Phew… .

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I will help you too.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Edam is already doing his part just by existing.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. If you were Yeonhee, didn’t you go to the western part of Freios?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: For some reason, he got separated from his group on his way and got lost, so he came back to the gate.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I have a feeling that I will be able to see Yeonhee often at the gateway in the future. Edam is also in charge of protecting lost children, so it should be okay.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: When you leave, you promised to take a good look around.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha, nothing else is happening, right?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: … Yes, nothing major right now, but is there something you need help with? Just tell me and I will help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I just wanted to hear a little bit of the story.
(Edam nods his head quietly as if he understands.)

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Notos, why don't you tell %s that?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: … Is that so, Mr. Edam? %s, this is none other than… . I lost a letter to deliver to my brother.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A letter?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: My father always wrote letters to express his feelings. He said that if it is difficult to express your feelings in words, express your feelings in a sincere letter.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: … So, whenever I had a fight with my younger brother, I always sent him a letter and asked for reconciliation. However, as the route to Zephyrus changed, the letters I sent were returned... , haha… .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: There's an engraving on it that can only be seen with the magic of my family, but I guess I don't like it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. But where did you lose that letter?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: … It's a shame, but it's my room. It's my mistake. You forgot that the wind blowing here is sensitive to magical power... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I was sorting out returned letters with the window open, when the wind blew inside and blew these letters outside.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It seems like there is almost no way to find it since you have to go into a magical vortex.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: … I quickly tried to figure out where the wind was heading... , it was an island.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aie Island… . I'll go and take a look.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Would you mind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to go again, so you don't have to be sorry. I'm just looking for it on the way, so don't have high expectations... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Thank you anyway, %s. Oh, you can just use the gate to Aie Island.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, wasn't the gate to Aie Island closed?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: The gate's operation method has been changed so that only a few people, including %s, can use it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. See you later, you two.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I hope you get to the island without any problems.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: See you later, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Will I learn something if I meet Hayden?)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Hello %s.
(Hayden smiles brightly and makes eye contact. Of course, he doesn’t forget to greet Marie with her hands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hayden, how about the island?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: He… . No, without Circe everything went back to normal.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I think both Scylla and Glaucus are doing well because they are getting enough rest. Even though Circe's curse has not been lifted... .

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I don’t think you view the current situation too negatively. I hope you find a way quickly and return to your original state.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I find out how, I'll tell you too.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: As expected, he is a good person… .

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Thank you for coming to Aie Island. All beings on the island, including Glaucus, welcome Adventurer.
(With Hayden's words, dolls that were not seen just a moment ago suddenly appear from behind.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Now, welcome applause!
(The dolls follow Hayden's instructions and clap for Adventurer. Then they disappear somewhere as if nothing had happened.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, those dolls... .

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: … It's a doll.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What does that mean? The dolls that were here were obviously cursed... .

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: As people were freed from the curse, a lot of useful cotton fell here and there. So I collected the cotton and made a doll.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Out of curiosity, what did you make the doll for?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Because of Circe's curse, many spirits and fairies left or died. I was able to bring a few people back to life... , it couldn't maintain its original appearance... .

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: So I made it go inside the doll. Glaucus also blessed me, so I was able to move stably.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Iris The goddess also promised that, although not now, she would help me return to my original form later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… , I see.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Is there something you are looking for? An hourglass or something else?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hayden also knows about the hourglass.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Another spirit told me that Adventurer was looking for an hourglass that had fallen from Pneuma.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Other than that, can you tell me what you're looking for?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm looking for a letter that flew on the wind.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Letter… ? ah!
(When Hayden looks like he knows something, Marie, the doll in his arms, raises her arms and shows something.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Is this it? Seeing as how much magic power is left, it seems important... .
(Hayden delivers a letter that appears to be from Notos to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I think that's right. Are there any more?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I only have this one, but it seems like all the letters carried by the wind were brought to Aie Island. Oh, you have to hurry.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Although it is subtle, it is an item that contains magical power, so the dolls and demons may have reacted to it. Maybe they tore it up or used it for something else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's the reason, I need to find it quickly.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: After finding the letter and returning it to its owner, go to the location that comes to mind. Then the hidden hourglass will wake up.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: If you find it, bring it to me. I'll send it back to Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Hayden. Then I'll go find it right away.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Yes, and… . Oh, you're already gone.
(Hayden looks at the back of Adventurer and lifts Marie's arm and pretends to scratch her head.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I wanted to help you because you have a lot of letters. I hope you don't mind, Marie? huh? You think Adventurer will be okay?

steps.name: Color of emotions (11)
steps.objective: Defeat [Zephyros] at the “Magic Training Center” to obtain the <Yellow Hourglass>.   Then visit [Hayden] on “Aie Island” and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: %s, are you here?
(Notos sees %s coming from afar and rushes over.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: No, I never thought you would find all of this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There were more letters than I expected. I never thought there would be 50 letters... . I felt like I suddenly became a postman.
(Notos’s eyes are filled with tears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry, I made a joke without notice. I didn't say this with bad intentions.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Haha, no. it's okay. It's my fault for not talking properly with my brother.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Because they are so hated that they don't even accept letters.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, please get the letter.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work. How should I repay this favor?
(Notos smiles brightly after receiving the lost letter from %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Because it wasn't something I was hoping for.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Did you finish your personal work well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not yet. I thought there might be some clues after visiting the island... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If the hourglass had been on Aie Island, Hayden would have told the story...)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: If you don't mind, would you please listen to my story?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: The reason I kept writing letters to Zephyrus was because I wanted to make peace. The paths of magic we pursue are different, and as a family... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: 10 years ago, my father died in an accident. When only the two of us were left, we were in a difficult situation.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Like the boy who is the protagonist of a common heroic story, I hoped for the good fortune of quickly rising up and becoming the center of the world.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: God seemed to have heard the boy's wish, and with the help of many people, we were fortunate enough to be able to attend a small boarding school in the capital.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: My younger brother was popular, so he had affairs with girls. I suddenly remember a girl telling me that if I wear glasses, she will break them. Her name is Chloris... . Oh, he... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . Zephyros and Chloris, you two... . You work at school.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I was surprised to hear that story. ha ha ha. I don't know what the relationship between the two is like now... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: When we graduated, we naturally ended up working at the Magic Agency. And I found out something by chance.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: There was the intervention of the Magic Agency in what happened 10 years ago... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What exactly is that?
(Notos is embarrassed by %s’s question.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Ah… . I thought you knew a lot about it. Because you did something related to His Majesty... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know exactly... . I just feel like something bad happened.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I see. You might find out when the time comes. I'll keep quiet for now. sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No… .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Haha, I can tell you more than that. At that time, my younger brother and I had a big fight because we didn't agree with each other... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I left the Magic Agency and went to the Sage's Tower... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Someday, I want to talk to my younger brother face to face. I shouldn't have said it so carelessly... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He's a good brother. It will happen someday.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Thank you, %s. As brothers, friends, and fellow souls, we should be a little more honest.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Because they're twins.
(Notos stretches out with a relieved expression on his face.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: The time has already come. I have to go back to work now, but what is your schedule, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I… . Suddenly a place to go came to mind!

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Where are you going?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a secret. Ahaha, for a moment I felt like I was imitating someone… .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: If so, we will see you off. You're going towards the guild union, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. yes? Phew, yes… . that's right. Since I got caught, there's nothing I can do.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Haha, I hope everything goes well on your way. See you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Notos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I can feel my feelings for my younger brother. If there's a place that comes to mind, I think it's a magic academy... Should I go to the training center first and look for it?)
(While looking around with the help of the Magic Academy Student Council, I found something shining yellow on one side.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It was here, I'm glad I found it sooner than expected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel happy just looking at it... . Just wanting someone to be happy... . Oh, that's right. It seems like the yellow hourglass contains the emotion of happiness... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I want to be happy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, is it because of the influence of the hourglass? Phew, what are you talking about? I have to go see Hayden quickly.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Adventurer, welcome.
(This time, Hayden is waving and welcoming the doll Marie.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: From the moment Adventurer stepped onto the island, a happy feeling came over me.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I had no idea that this hourglass, which contains some of the emotions of many living beings, would be such a powerful force. If I, a spirit, could feel something like that... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks to Hayden, I was able to find it quickly.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Rather, I am grateful. Spirits are beings that work for life, but they cannot easily feel these emotions.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I am so lucky to be able to feel this emotion. I’m glad I met Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Marie, are you lucky too?
(Hayden makes a nodding gesture as if he were saying the same thing to the doll Marie.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks, Hayden.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Then will you give me an hourglass?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here. To make this hourglass disappear, you need the power of the spirit. So does Hayden also memorize special spells or do special actions?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I didn't prepare anything like that... . I have heard that there is a spirit that casts spells. But not me.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Come on, Marie. Are you ready?
(Hayden puts the doll Marie down on a nearby rock. Marie nods as if she understands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you see Marie move just now? I didn't see it wrong, right?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Well, I don’t know? Hehe… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He's trying to cover up the situation with a completely clueless expression and a smile... Let's watch for now.)
(Marie receives the yellow hourglass from Hayden and begins to spin it round and round. After a while, yellow light flows out from within the hourglass and scatters across the island.)
(Mari, who had been spinning around for a while, sits down, feeling dizzy.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Marie, great job. I'm taking a break.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think it's definitely over.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: The emotional sand has returned to where it should go.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. The container containing the sand has not disappeared and remains. It can't be helped.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I guess it would be better to send this back to where it came from, right?
(Hayden laughs lightly and throws the empty hourglass toward the sky. The empty hourglass seems to be flowing somewhere along a vortex of magical power and then quickly disappears.)
Pour!
(The sound of an owl suffering from being hit by something is heard from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it because of my mood? I think I heard the sound of an owl being hit by something... .

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: The empty hourglass has gone into the pneuma, so don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: There are only two left now, right? Feelings of passion and love, feelings of hope and hope for peace... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think so.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I don't know where or how Adventurer will meet the other two hourglasses... .

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I don't think it has shown up yet. If it appears somewhere, the spirits will feel it.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Come on, Marie. Come here.
(Hayden brings the collapsed Marie back into his arms and hugs her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Again, thank you. Hayden. See you later then.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: No, Adventurer. If you need any help in the future, please let us know. Spirits are beings that work for life.
(Hayden brings the fallen Marie back into his arms and hugs her. Marie, who was moving just a moment ago, stops moving like a real doll.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … As expected, the world is full of things I cannot understand. Same with that doll... . Someday, I'll be able to find the other two hourglasses... .
(In an instant, Marie's flinching comes into Adventurer's field of vision.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think it still moved for a moment... Let's just pretend not to notice.)
